$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor completion

run.description: Shell command; `{files}` expands to the changed files

fix.description: Shell command run just before the check on every pass except the baseline, so an LLM fix only sees what it leaves failing; `{files}` expands to the changed files

lock.description: Lock resource held while the check runs

format.description: Shell command run on the changed files after every agent step, before checks; `{files}` expands to the changed files

disable.description: Built-in reviewers to disable, by name

clef.description: Ask Cloudflare Clef for the decisions that deterministic rules leave open: which reviewers and convention topics a change needs, the reviewer model for its risk, whether a must-fix is only a taste remark, how severe an unlabelled review thread is, and whether failing checks are unrelated to the change. Each falls back to the deterministic behaviour when Clef is off or unavailable; needs `ship auth cloudflare`

trustedBots.description: Bot accounts whose review comments `ship fix` and `ship recheck` act on, by login (e.g. `coderabbitai`). A bot may not push to the repository, so its comments are ignored unless listed here

draft.description: Open the PR as a draft; always a draft when escalated

squash.description: Squash to one commit before opening the PR

models.description: Agent model per step; overrides the global config

checkFixAttempts.description: Check-fix attempts per round before escalating (M)

caps.description: Loop caps before escalating; overrides the global config

timeouts.description: Timeout per step. baseline and checks apply to each check command and review to each reviewer call; time spent waiting for a lock does not count; overrides the global config
